description: Get one deck: its phase, concept preview, slides, and slideImageUrls (ordered, ready to post). Pass waitSeconds to wait for drafting or rendering to finish instead of polling.

deckId.description: Deck id from genppt_list_decks, genppt_create_deck, or genppt_create_slideshow.

waitSeconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds while the deck is drafting or rendering, and return when the phase changes. Default 0.

name: genppt_get_deck
title: Get deck
